cohort: 188 pregnant women (94 with pre-eclampsia and 94 normotensive)
finding: Maternal serum levels of Ang-2, but not Ang-1, were significantly lower in women with pre-eclampsia compared to normotensive pregnant women.
mod_finding: Women who delivered vaginally had significantly higher maternal serum levels of Ang-1 compared to women who had a cesarean section.
